Answer: A
Reason: Figure 1 shows focal nodular opacities in the right lung (indicated by arrows), while Figure 2 demonstrates a significant progression to diffuse, hazy opacification involving the entire right hemithorax. This radiographic worsening, combined with the clinical symptoms of pain and crackles in the same region 18 days after admission for COVID-19, is most consistent with the progression of viral pneumonia.
